verdict.rationale: The Mesh docs say API credentials are created under Settings > Access Management > API Credentials, where you can configure their permissions and an optional expiry date. Endpoint reference pages name the specific permissions each call needs, which suggests a granular permission model for least-privilege keys. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the permission catalogue and its granularity, agent-specific credential guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: These can be generated in the ComplyAdvantage Mesh web application under Settings > Access Management > API Credentials, where you can also configure their permissions and optional expiry date.
You need the "View roles in account" permission to use this endpoint.
